# Simple Flying

> Leading independent source for aviation news, industry insight, and aircraft analysis covering airlines, aircraft types, and global aviation developments.

Simple Flying provides comprehensive coverage of the commercial aviation industry, including breaking news, aircraft fleet analysis, airline operations, and passenger experience insights. The site features interactive seat maps, video content, and expert analysis on major aviation topics including Boeing and Airbus aircraft, airline strategies, and geopolitical impacts on aviation.

## Key Topics

- Boeing aircraft (737 MAX, 747, 717, 787)
- Airbus A380
- American Airlines
- Delta Air Lines
- Emirates
- Singapore Airlines
- Middle East conflict impacts
- Aircraft operations and fleet management
- Airline seat configurations
- Aviation industry news
- Supply chain disruptions
- Passenger experience
- Aircraft procurement strategy
- Cabin crew operations
- IATA codes
